releaseNotes: Production Records PDF now follows Configuration > PDF & Reports: company header with logo, chosen electrical fields, Status column, and one I-V chart per module (single or dual as configured) with the optional data points table. Data sheets and the record popup now show the I-V curve for records with no stored curve (built from Voc/Isc/Vmp/Imp, as the Scan Station does). Re-writing a tag no longer erases a stored I-V curve.
